run_split_features: run the MNIST dataset feature split between two parties using a configurable ratio
run_split_observations: run the MNIST dataset observation split between two parties using a configurable ratio
run_split_features_v_labels: run the MNIST split giving one party features and the other party labels
run_split_train_v_test: run the MNIST split giving one party training data and the other test data
run_get_norm_mnist: run the MNIST download and normalization with optional binary classification and reduced dataset size
